# External author implementations

The recent-backbone experiment uses pinned public implementations. Clone them
into this directory before running `experiments/recent_backbones.py`:

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/Young0222/TeRDy.git TeRDy
git -C TeRDy checkout f3f47986adb97eee26ac2e59811dc0d02df570f4
git clone https://github.com/AAristotle/LTGQ.git LTGQ
git -C LTGQ checkout 4617c8af7dfe1c12bc9f36f074923c2a73e3046b
```

The TFLEX query-format provenance is available at
`https://github.com/LinXueyuanStdio/TFLEX`.
